stories.title: Aurora Grid Reports Higher Storage Orders
stories.summary: Aurora Grid said quarterly storage orders rose after a new utility contract expanded its project backlog.
stories.body: Aurora Grid reported a rise in quarterly orders for its modular battery systems.

stories.title: Northline Retail Updates Its Seasonal Outlook
stories.summary: Northline Retail raised the lower end of its seasonal sales outlook as early demand improved across home and outdoor categories.
stories.body: Northline Retail raised the lower end of its seasonal comparable-sales forecast.

stories.title: Calder Ridge Bank Expands Small-Business Lending Pilot
stories.summary: Calder Ridge Bank is extending a small-business lending pilot to four additional markets after an initial six-month trial.
stories.body: Calder Ridge Bank said it will extend its small-business lending pilot.

stories.title: Meridian Freight Trims Annual Fuel-Cost Forecast
stories.summary: Meridian Freight lowered its annual fuel-cost estimate after route changes reduced empty miles during the summer.
stories.body: Meridian Freight lowered its projected annual fuel expense.

stories.title: Harborlight Foods Plans Regional Distribution Hub
stories.summary: Harborlight Foods plans to open a regional distribution hub intended to shorten delivery times for independent grocers.
stories.body: Harborlight Foods plans to open a regional distribution hub outside Pinehaven.
